correctness.rationale: For F_m=K1∨(m K2), a total restrained dominating set is exactly the apex plus a nonempty union of whole edge blades: without apex the total domination forces all peripheral vertices and violates outside restraint; with apex, outside restraint forbids half blades. For two blocks the apex-containing block may be any non-TRD subset, giving 4^m-2^m+1. For k>=3, every other block must partner the apex block; if it split a blade every partner would require its unique missing endpoint, impossible for two partners, while a whole blade would make the apex block TRD. Thus apex alone, remaining blocks an unordered partition of m blades, counted by S(m,k-1). The coalition graph is K1,k-1, total 4^m-2^m+Bell(m), unique maximum m+1. Independent exhaustive adjacency-based subset+set-partition enumeration verified m=1,2,3 (counts 3; 13+1; 57+3+1).
